additional_info.body:
Hi Orel,
We have analyzed the logs and found that the LOGO PLC version is old i.e.
FW-Version: v2.1.0
We need to update the LOGO FW to latest v2.7.0
Hope it will solve the issue.
Do let us know, if issue persists. We can provide you further instructions if needed.
